name: dynamic storage constructor arguments retain actual values
source: class Holder { constructor(value: number[], original: any) { const exposed: any = value; exposed[0] = original; } } function main(): void { const values: number[] = []; const original: any = {x: 7}; const holder = new Holder(values, original); console.log(values[0] === original, typeof values[0], values[0].x); }
